text: 直脚着地两帧，再旁边点两帧，再旁边点两帧，再旁边点俩帧，依次类推
meaning: Each foot remains in contact across four progressively changing relative positions, each position rendered as2 distinct poses. Forward landing, body over foot, early rear support, rear toe-off. No lateral turnout, duplicate art, interpolation or whole-character shift.

segments.position: P1 forward landing, nearly straight natural knee
P2 under hip, body passes support
P3 slightly behind body, sustained support
P4 rear toe-off, front part of sole stays in contact

supportLegsByDirection: Direction agents must bind physical legs using actual images
